flags.why: The example explains what the word is called instead of using it in context.
flags.fix: Con xuyên sơn cuộn mình lại khi gặp nguy hiểm. = The pangolin curls up when threatened.

flags.why: This fishing implement's name belongs mainly to Southern Vietnamese, as documented in [research on Nam Bộ vocabulary](https://scholar.dlu.edu.vn/thuvienso/bitstream/DLU123456789/132262/1/CVv517S022020014.pdf).

The word describes going round in circles or fussing about without progress, rather than being tied down by responsibilities; see [Southern usage](https://thuviennguyenanninh.vn/blog/chuyen-chu-nghia-phuong-nam-ca-re-xa-quan-ca-rich-ca-tang-cham-thi-goi-sao-cung-duoc-ma.html).
flags.fix: to go round in circles; to fuss about without getting anywhere

flags.why: This is mainly a Southern expression, as identified in [this account of Nam Bộ vocabulary](https://nghengu.vn/tieng-nghe-cua-toi/xa-quang-hay-xa-quan-1986.html).

flags.fix: spent firecracker casings; paper debris left after firecrackers explode
